title: Proposed DeepFlow Bridge Event - NOT native DeepFlow payload
description: Contract for a custom DeepFlow push template output. Verify every template variable against a real v7.2.3 installation.

source_version.description: Actual pushing instance version within adapter family v7_2 (W1 pins target minor; was const 7.2.3 before v7.2.4 release)

external_event_id.description: Maps to official AlertEvent.event_id; preferred recovery correlation key

event_state.description: Maps to official AlertEvent.state: 0=Ongoing, 1=Ended; strongly recommended for episode alignment

starts_at.description: Maps to official AlertEvent.start_time (unix seconds); pair with ends_at for lifecycle bounds

event_level.description: String levels map 1:1 to official enum event_level: 1=Critical 2=Error 3=Warn 4=NoData 5=Recovered 6=Info
